entities.summary: Charles James Elleby is an American professional basketball player for Hapoel Be'er Sheva of the Israeli Basketball Premier League. He played college basketball for the Washington State Cougars, and was drafted in the 2nd round of the 2020 NBA Draft by the Portland Trail Blazers.
